Share.d:
Build, organize and share reusable task presets: name, priority, parameters, pass variables and return value. Includes search, bulk actions, and export/import.

This project is only a tool to create presets in JSON that can be used in other shares.

For best compatibility use 6.7.6-beta or newer version of tasker and clean import this project.
